Let me drop retry_safe.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_0EdVd3D7fzrh3RNtMvA73921","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"content": "import { run, step } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nstructural OrderProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): OrderProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"idempotency-key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing idempotency-key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    const reserved = step(\"reserve\", () => ({ reserved: true }));\n    const notified = call(\"notify\", {\n      method: \"POST\",\n      headers: { \"content-type\": \"application/json\" },\n      body: JSON.stringify(reserved)\n    });\n    return Response.json({ notified: notified.status }, { status: 201 });\n  });\n}\n", "file": "handler.ts"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":31079,"completion_tokens":720,"total_tokens":31799,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":30848},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":370},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":30848,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":231},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
